population.description: Adults with joint discomfort or engaged in regular exercise

gradeRationale.note: Of four outcome categories studied (body composition, collagen synthesis, exercise recovery, joint pain/function), joint pain/functionality was the most consistent finding - the basis for grading Moderate here rather than Limited.

statement: Collagen peptide supplementation improves joint pain and functionality, the most consistent benefit found across the outcomes this evidence base examined.

citations.title: The effects of collagen peptide supplementation on body composition, collagen synthesis, and recovery from joint injury and exercise: a systematic review

review.note: Drafted from master research list v2 (2026-09-05).
